text.title: 解释过程的标签
text.situation:
流程屏展示合成材料的制造。第一格说明研究者通过化学反应把较简单材料结合，合成一种物质，下一格将过程称为合成。另一动画展示一个反应引起后续反应，即连锁反应。过道对面，录制燃烧演示显示燃料燃烧释放能量。旁边模型用转动叶片利用流动空气的能量，为小灯发电。玛雅等到灯亮。两场展示都涉及能量，但这个模型不需要烧邻屏展示的燃料。

乔：synthesis 是成品的名称吗？
讲解员：这里是过程名称。
玛雅：这盏灯靠燃料燃烧供电吗？
讲解员：不是，沿电线看回叶片转动的模型。

paragraphs.en: A process screen followed the manufacture of a synthetic material. Its first panel explained that researchers synthesize a substance by combining simpler materials through chemical reactions. The next panel called the process synthesis. A separate animation showed one reaction starting further reactions: a chain reaction. Across the aisle, a recorded combustion display showed fuel releasing energy as it burned. A model beside it used turning blades to harness the energy of moving air and generate electricity for a small lamp. Maya waited until the lamp lit up. The two displays involved energy, but the model did not need to burn the fuel shown on the neighbouring screen.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is synthesis the name of the finished material?
Guide: Here it names the process.
Maya: And this lamp is powered by burning fuel?
Guide: No. Follow the cable back to the model with the turning blades.
